# Verification & Validation Skill

Verification asks: did we build the system according to approved specification/contracts? Validation asks: does the result solve the intended user/business problem? Perform both separately. For each acceptance criterion record method, environment, build/commit, test or inspection, evidence, result (PASS/FAIL/NOT RUN/BLOCKED), defect ID and reviewer. Do not convert NOT RUN into PASS. Use independent review for high-risk slices. Summarize residual risk and obtain human acceptance.
